title: Rental Property Service Contracts Tenure Credit Table for Late Renewals
content:
**Credit rule.** A Rental Property Service Contracts late-renewal premium carries a tenure credit set by how long before the late renewal date the contract was originally purchased.

| Original purchase date of the contract | Tenure credit |
|---|---|
| 1095 days or more before the late renewal date | 0.04 |
| 730 to 1094 days before it | 0.02 |
| fewer than 730 days before it | 0 |

The original purchase date is the start date on the contract; the days are the calendar days from it to the late renewal date.

**How the credit acts.** Every loading and credit on a late-renewal premium enters one adjustment rate — loadings added, credits subtracted — and the premium is multiplied once by one plus that rate, before rounding.

## Boundaries

| Days from the original purchase date to the late renewal date | Credit |
|---|---|
| 729 | 0 |
| 730 | 0.02 |
| 1094 | 0.02 |
| 1095 | 0.04 |
